content.text: * RequiredUse my locationOpens a simulated dialog*Appointment location preference* Who is the appointment for?An individual (all vaccines)A group of 2-4 (flu and/or COVID-19 only)NextBy continuing, you agree to the Walgreens Terms of Use Opens in a new tab and Privacy policy Opens in a new tab. Walgreens Pharmacy administers applicable vaccinations for children ages three and older. State and age restrictions may apply. Patients under 18 years old (under 16 in South Carolina, under 19 years of age in Nebraska, or under 21 in Puerto Rico) must be accompanied by a parent or guardian to receive their vaccination. Vaccines are subject to availability; certain vaccines may not be available in all stores.We may contact the patient if they are unable to complete the appointment, or to notify them of any updates or changes to the appointment. Standard email is not a secure means of communication. The patient's protected health information that may be contained in our emails to them will not be encrypted. This means there is a risk the patient's protected health information in the emails could be intercepted and read by, or disclosed to, unauthorized third parties. By entering the patient's email and selecting “Next”, the patient agrees to accept the risks associated with non-secure, unencrypted email communications from us containing their protected health information.No cost to you with most insurance. Vaccines are subject to availability. State-, age- and health-related restrictions may apply.
